note: Adapted from the species-level description of Emerson (1928), originally in English; only the soldier is known, workers and alates are not recorded; the description is based on 2 soldiers and several workers; figure numbers, localities, nomenclatural remarks and Kohl's field observations are omitted.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: Differs from all other known species in the completely hairless and seta-free head surface, the larger size and the mandibular dentition.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head oval, yellow; hairs and setae almost absent, only one or two on the vertex. Postmentum very broad. Antennae 15-segmented, third and fourth segments equal in length, shorter than the second. Inner margin of the left mandible slightly serrate. Inner margin of the right mandible with two minute teeth, one before the middle and one near the basal boss. Pronotum paler than the head; anterior and posterior margins both emarginate; densely setose. Abdominal tergites with numerous setae. Head length 2.07 mm; head width 1.10 mm; antennal length 1.57 mm; pronotum length 0.50 mm, width 0.87 mm; hind tibia length 0.95 mm; left mandible length 0.73 mm.
